sites.name: Brú na Bóinne (Newgrange and Knowth)
sites.era: ancient (era not stated on the pages read)
sites.what: Passage tombs reached by shuttle bus from the visitor centre.

access.tickets: Pre-booking is essential and every visitor including infants needs a ticket; unaccompanied under-18s are not admitted.
access.permits: Access to Newgrange and Knowth is by guided tour only.
access.photography: Not permitted in the passage or chamber at Newgrange; commercial filming or photography needs a permit.
